description: Host header values and whether each names a loopback target. A plugin that receives a connection on a loopback address SHOULD refuse any request whose Host is not loopback by this table (403 "forbidden host"). Rule: an empty Host is loopback; a port is stripped; IPv6 brackets are trimmed; the names localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1 match case-sensitively; any other value is loopback only if it parses as a loopback IP address, an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address included, and a value with an IPv6 zone (::1%lo) is not. The backend's Go rule and the bundled plugin's Python rule are both tested against this file.
